name: On Record Credits
author: kellybransford

sections.description:
On Record Credits is the easiest way for music producers, recording engineers, and songwriters to showcase their production credits on a WordPress website.

Built for the people behind the music — if you produce records, mix albums, co-write songs, or engineer sessions, this plugin gives you a clean, professional way to display your work without touching a single line of code.

Why On Record Credits?

Most musicians and producers either list their credits in a wall of text, a basic table, or don’t display them at all. On Record Credits changes that — giving you a beautiful, interactive accordion display that lets visitors browse your work by artist.

How it works

  1. Add credits from your WordPress dashboard — artist name, song title, your role, and album artwork
  2. Drop the [on_record_credits] shortcode on any page
  3. Your credits display in a clean, interactive accordion layout — click an artist to see their songs

That’s it. No code, no complicated setup, no page builder required (though it works great with Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, and any other builder).

Features

  • Credits dashboard — add and manage credits directly from WordPress admin
  • Album artwork — assign cover art from your Media Library with one click
  • Accordion display — clean, interactive layout grouped by artist
  • Full color customization — match your site’s colors exactly
  • Custom heading — change the section title to anything you want
  • Order control — arrange credits using the built-in order field
  • Shortcode — works on any page, post, or page builder widget
  • Mobile responsive — looks sharp on every device
  • Elementor compatible — drop the shortcode widget anywhere

Shortcode

Add [on_record_credits] to any page, post, or Elementor Shortcode widget.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services. All data is stored locally in your WordPress database.

Google Fonts (Cormorant Garamond and Inconsolata) are loaded from fonts.googleapis.com for the display typography. No personal data is transmitted. See Google’s privacy policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy and terms of service: https://policies.google.com/terms.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/on-record-credits
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress
  3. Go to On Record Credits > Add New Credit to add your first credit
  4. Go to On Record Credits > Settings to customize colors and heading
  5. Add [on_record_credits] to any page or Elementor Shortcode widget
sections.faq:
What shortcode do I use?

Add [on_record_credits] to any page, post, or Elementor Shortcode widget.

Does this work with Elementor?

Yes — drag a Shortcode widget onto your page and type [on_record_credits].

Can I customize the colors?

Yes — go to On Record Credits > Settings to change background, text, accent, and border colors.

How do I control the order credits appear?

Open any credit and use the Order field in Page Attributes. Lower numbers appear first.

Can I add album artwork?

Yes — when editing a credit, click Choose Image to pick artwork from your Media Library.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — fully responsive and optimized for mobile.
